Welcome! First off, taking this step is huge, and it is completely normal to feel nervous. Starting something totally new at 52 takes real guts, but you are in the right place and we are going to take this one steady step at a time. 

If you have any underlying health conditions or concerns, it's always a good idea to check in with your doctor before starting a new routine. 

Your plan is built for beginners, starting with simple, manageable movements like easy walks to get your momentum going without overwhelming your body. You don't need to prove anything or push to exhaustion—showing up is the only victory that matters right now.
